prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Yang Hu of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the virtuous border commander who became friends with the enemy general.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.


Original detailed design: Adult woman about twenty, fair skin, tall curvaceous build with full bust, narrow waist and naturally proportioned long legs. Gentle reassuring smile. Small oval face, jade-green eyes, violet hair in a long sleek high ponytail. Choose silhouette 2: large symmetrical wing binder plates, light body armour, all rigid metal. Wing plates interlock inward into a protective bridge, symbolizing benevolent border defence. Navy-black armour, silver edges, ivory and plum details, blue glow lines. Bare waist and upper thighs at designed openings; intimate areas covered. One hand holds a green-core alloy pendant on a green cord; other relaxed. Orbital deck over a blue planet, neutral key and strong rim light.
Composition: vertical 2:3, 1024x1536, entire headpiece to both feet inside with clear margins, figure about four-fifths image height, chest-height camera and natural perspective. One woman, one head, two connected arms and two legs. Both hands visible with five fingers each. No other person or creature, text, logo, watermark or frame. Whole costume is solid hard-surface armour with thickness, joints and panel lines except the stated skin openings; face and hair human, no cloth gown. Far-future setting only.
